components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; min-height: 56px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #151515); background: var(--paper, #fcfcfa); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; font: 600 16px/1 "Barlow Semi Condensed", Barlow, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #4f555c); text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #151515); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--ink, #151515); } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--ink, #151515); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--ink, #151515); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--ink, #151515); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-grid; place-content: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; background: var(--signal, #ff5b14); color: var(--ink, #151515); font: 700 12px/1 "Barlow Semi Condensed", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The supply is drawn, not charted. Every screen is a sheet from a furniture assembly drawing: a double-ruled sheet frame, a title block (Schriftfeld), the cellar shelf in front elevation with one board per food group, numbered circular callouts bound to a parts list (Stückliste), and dimension lines that measure "Tage versorgt". Packages are line drawings; how full the shelf is reads from line form and hatching, not from bars, cards or traffic lights.

The world is monochrome ink on white paper. A pencil grey carries construction lines and missing items, a pale fill tone marks hover and selection, and a single signal orange is held back for best-before (MHD) attention. Density is that of a technical drawing: compact condensed labels, tabular figures, hairline rules between rows, 2px rules between zones. Calm, exact and quietly complete, never alarmist.

The world explicitly refuses the KPI-card dashboard: no progress bars, no traffic-light badges, no rounded pills, no drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on paper, one held-back signal accent.
State is line form: hatched solid = stocked, dashed = planned/missing, doubled outline = bald fällig, struck through in signal = abgelaufen.
Numbered circular callouts link the drawing to the parts list; hovering either lights both.
Square corners and square line caps everywhere; the circle belongs to callouts alone.
Condensed grotesk for labels and figures, tabular numerals in every quantity.

rules.name: The Held-Back Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal orange means "look at this MHD" and nothing else. It never decorates, never marks navigation or primary actions, and never appears without a text state ("fällig", "abgelaufen") beside it.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state carried by colour is also carried by line form or text: doubled outline plus "bald fällig", strike line plus "abgelaufen", double underline for "bald fällig" in tables.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every quantity, date, callout number and badge uses tabular lining numerals so columns and dimension values align like a parts list.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Labels on the drawing (boards, slots, legends, title-block fields, controls) are set in the condensed face; continuous reading text is set in the regular face. Labels stay sentence case; no tracked uppercase.

rules.name: The Drafted Depth Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand apart, give it a heavier rule, a hatch or an ink fill. Never a shadow, blur or gradient lift.

dos: Do draw state as line form first (hatch, dash, double outline, strike) and add signal orange only for MHD attention.
Do separate zones with 2px ink rules and rows with 1px hairlines instead of cards, gaps or shadows.
Do number anything drawn with a circular callout and give it a matching parts-list row; hovering one lights the other.
Do use tabular figures for every quantity, date and number.
Do mark focus with the 2px dashed ink outline.
Do draw icons inline as SVG strokes at 2px with square caps and mitred joins.
Do keep motion to one-time drawing gestures (hatch filling, lines drawing out) and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't use progress bars, KPI cards or traffic-light badges to show stock.
Don't round controls or containers; the circle is reserved for callouts.
Don't add drop shadows, blurs or gradient lifts.
Don't use signal orange for navigation, primary actions or decoration.
Don't communicate any state by colour alone.
Don't load fonts from a CDN; the faces are self-hosted.
